strategic_assessment.headline: POSSIBLE is 17 days away and Cleo's content engine has never run — the proof-of-voice that should front-run every Nell email still doesn't exist.
strategic_assessment.body:
Two things that haven't moved since yesterday now have real time pressure: Leo's 13 funnel fixes are still pending Krish approval, and Cleo's Content Engine Weekly Sweep has zero executions — not slow, literally never run. These two facts together create a compounding problem. Nell's outreach emails land colder every day there's no content trail behind Krish's name. Even if a buyer wants to move forward, they can't — Stripe is off, CTAs are broken, Sprint pages show no price. The sequencing is still backwards and the window is getting smaller.

Today's Zara signals reframe the urgency in a useful way. Sierra raised $100M this week while Bret Taylor declared the era of clicking buttons is over — that's the Mindmaker thesis being validated by institutional capital in real time. MIT research showing 95% of enterprise AI pilots deliver no measurable ROI is circulating in enterprise content channels right now. These are live content hooks, gift-wrapped, that Cleo should be drafting against this weekend. The buyers who will show up at POSSIBLE in 17 days are reading this material. Krish should be the voice shaping how they interpret it — instead, there is no content.

One genuinely new development: Nova now owns podcast and stage visibility with 56 shows mapped across 8 categories, and the visibility agent has 4 pitches drafted. That's a real pipeline that didn't exist 72 hours ago. None of those pitches have been sent yet, but they're queued — one Krish decision away from launch. Meanwhile, a high-engagement DC-area physical event on AI content strategy is six days out (Vienna, April 16, 67 RSVPs). Nova should be pitching Krish as a panelist before Monday.
strategic_assessment.recommended_focus: Approve Cleo's content plan today — POSSIBLE is 17 days away and live content hooks (Sierra's $100M raise, MIT's 95% stat) are peaking now. Then clear Leo's top 3 funnel fixes so the buyers Cleo drives have somewhere to land. These two decisions, 25 minutes, unblock everything.
